title: focuser_primaluce ended moves of a motor flagged for calibration ALERT without the reason
summary: A SESTO SENSO 3 ARCO flagged for calibration (CALRESTART.MOT2 1) acknowledges MOVE_ABS and does not turn; the move ended ALERT with no message. The driver sent the calibration notice at connect only.
evidence: 20261023101445-b9b5-primaluce-needs-calibration-message/verification.md (FND); server log of the hardware session 2026-10-23

resolution.evidence: 20261023101445-b9b5-primaluce-needs-calibration-message/verification.md: moves of a motor flagged by CALRESTART name the calibration as the reason; sestosenso3_rotator_needs_calibration and needs_calibration pass and fail without the change; recorded run 65/65; hardware ALERT with 'The rotator needs calibration'.
